name: Better Status Messages
description: Restyles Drupal's status/warning/error messages and adds a manual close (dismiss) button.
project_description: Better Status Messages restyles Drupal's core status, warning and error messages and adds a per-message close button so users can dismiss them. Out of the box, normal messages get white text on a green background and error messages white text on a red background, with a white close-button SVG. A settings form at Configuration > Development > Better Status Messages lets a site administrator override the five color values (status background/text, error background/text, and close-button fill). The restyling is applied only on non-admin (front-end) pages via a theme-suggestion override of core's status_messages theme hook; admin pages keep the standard Drupal message rendering. The module works with no configuration and has no dependencies beyond Drupal core.
